slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Which tool? If you know two sides of a right triangle and want the third, use the Pythagorean Theorem. If you know a side and an acute angle, use sin, cos or tan. If you know two sides and want an angle, use inverse trig. If the angle is 30, 45 or 60 degrees, special right triangles give exact answers.

Always sketch the triangle, mark the right angle, and label the sides opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse from the angle you are using.
